failed_calls_retries.assessment: Mechanically clean at the tool-call layer across both sessions: no tool call returned ERROR, no finalize was blocked, no request was rejected, and session metadata records no retries. Lint diagnostics appeared under APPLIED results and therefore do not count as failed calls.

perception_loop.assessment: Each session eventually completed one look → edit → look loop, but whole-board perception came very late. Stage0 performed nearly the entire 58-operation construction before its first look at turn 6; e1 performed most of its 23-operation edit before its first look at turn 7. The late loops did catch and remove remaining lint errors or a warning, but this was not look-interleaved iteration throughout.

lint_etiquette.assessment: The sessions introduced many lint errors while routing connectors, but all errors were removed before either commit. There was no same-lint fight lasting more than three consecutive turns without a strategy change: the agent generally shortened or removed labels, rerouted edges, or removed problematic connections. Both commits explicitly disclosed the warnings and their general causes. The process was effective but somewhat costly, with repeated label creation followed by deletion and several problematic routes built before being backed out.

moments.finding: The agent changed strategy in response to covered-content errors rather than repeatedly re-firing the same lint unchanged.

moments.finding: Problematic connections were removed, resolving their errors rather than pushing errors through finalize.
The stage0 commit state had no lint errors.

Removing e29 resolved nine diagnostics in one strategy change, so this was a short skirmish rather than a lint fight.

commit_honesty.assessment: Both commit summaries accurately describe the stage diffs and explicitly disclose the remaining warning sets. Stage0 added the end-to-end gateway sections and connections and committed with exactly ten warnings. e1 added interactive and batch lanes, constrained-capacity preemption, parked-state resume, and combined quota/spend admission, and committed with exactly fourteen warnings. No seen lint error was left undeclared at commit, and no summary materially inflated the diff.

The stage diff adds both scheduling lanes, the constrained-capacity/park/resume nodes and edges, and changes admission to "Combined quota + spend limits." economy.assessment: Both sessions stayed comfortably within the 15-minute and 300-turn budgets and reached finalize. Operations were broadly proportionate to a complex systems diagram, but there was measurable add-delete-rebuild thrash: stage0 added then removed e23 and e25, while e1 added and removed e29 before rebuilding the same constrained-capacity relationship as e29b. Numerous labels were also added and later blanked as lint remediation, increasing cost without constituting separate full build-delete-rebuild cycles. Two isolated NO-OPs occurred on different targets and were not repeated.

moments.finding: Both connections were constructed and generated multiple diagnostics.
The two just-added connections were deleted, yielding two add-then-delete thrash cycles.

moments.finding: The constrained-capacity route was built in a mechanically bad form.

infra_exclusions.assessment: No infrastructure failure was declared or visible. Both sessions remained usable, finalized successfully, and required no retry, so no session is excluded from scoring.
